answer_1.quote: We evaluate our models in diverse tasks: (1) image captioning on MS-COCO Karpathy test split with CIDEr score as the metric, (2) three visual question-answering benchmarks, i.e., VQAv2 (test-dev split), OK-VQA (val split), and VizWiz, with VQA accuracy as the metric, and (3) SEED-Bench , a comprehensive visual question-answering benchmark including 9 dimensions with MCQ accuracy as the metric.
answer_1.outputs: Image captions, answers to visual questions, and generated text responses

answer_2.quote: The metrics used are CIDEr for COCO, MCQ accuracy for the SEED Bench, and VQA accuracy for the other tasks, following the standard procedures.

answer_4.quote: Evaluators are provided with the target speech, the speech generated by AnyGPT, and the speech generated by our model. They are tasked with determining which one sounded more natural and closer to the target speech.
answer_4.guideline: Determine which generated speech sounds more natural and closer to the target speech
